races.name: Family Funday 31st May Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Crazy Cubana
runners_data.comment: 120,000gns yearling; has lots of stamina in pedigree but she needs checking in market
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 38,000euros foal, 120,000gns yearling; half-sister to winners Lancillotto (French 1m4f) and Bibiche (French 2m1f hurdle); dam 1m6f winner (RPR 79), half-sister to US 1m1f/1m4f Grade 2 winner Grandeur, out of half-sister to Doncaster Cup winner Far Cry; has lots of stamina in pedigree but she needs checking in market on debut.

runners_data.name: Havana Grey Star
runners_data.comment: 70,000gns yearling; has plenty of winners on dam's side and she's an interesting newcomer
runners_data.spotlight: February foal; 70,000gns yearling; first foal; dam French 8.5f winner (RPR 73), half-sister to winners Crooked Crown (5f 2yo), Flashy Snapper (1m), Blue Geranium (1m) and Kybosh (1m3f), out of maiden who was third in 1,000 Guineas; yard has had two 2yo winners this season and she needs a close look on debut.

runners_data.name: Knock Three Times
runners_data.comment: 95,000gns yearling; plenty to like on paper and she needs watching in market on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; tenth foal; half-sister to four winners including Khaadem (5f-6f including 2yo/dual Group 1; RPR 119), Log Out Island (5f/6f 2yo including Listed; 112) and Themainprotagonist (7f; 79); dam 5f 2yo/6f winner (70), half-sister to 6f Listed winner Lady Links; plenty to like on paper and interesting to see how she figures in market.

runners_data.name: Sahara Lake
runners_data.comment: Has fair standard to aim at on debut and she could be a longer-term prospect
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Inthar (1m2f-1m4f), Arabian Revolution (11.6f Flat/2m hurdle) and Emirates Skywards (1m5f), out of 1m4f Group 2 winner; has fair standard to aim at on debut and she could be a longer-term prospect on pedigree.

runners_data.name: Angel Sense
runners_data.comment: Promising second on Kempton debut last week and she should improve for the experience
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; £38,000 yearling; ran green after a slow start on Kempton debut (6f, AW; 17-2) last week but she got the hang of things in the closing stages and did well to finish runner-up behind the favourite; that was a promising start and she should know more this time; respected.

runners_data.name: Bayside
runners_data.comment: Won at Beverley three weeks ago and she's open to more progress upped in trip; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Cracksman filly who is out of half-sister to winners Hazzis (1m Group 3) and Whazzat (7f 2yo Listed); made a promising start when third at Bath (good) and she built on that when finishing well to land a Beverley novice (good to soft) ten days later; has a penalty but she looks a useful prospect and is open to more to progress on this step up in trip; key player.

races.name: Best Odds Guaranteed At Betano Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Flag Of Eva
runners_data.note: Lightly raced newcomer from a promising family but completely unknown quantity making her debut
runners_data.comment: This looks a tough starting point and he could be one for longer trips later on
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam 9.4f-16.6f winner (RPR 78), sister to 1m4f-2m4f Flat and 2m hurdle winner Timoshenko, half-sister to 1m-9.4f winner Nastenka, out of 1m4f/2m winner; this looks a tough starting point and he could be one for longer trips later on.

runners_data.name: Forever Endless
runners_data.note: Another debutant from struggling trainer Kevin Frost with poor recent form figures
runners_data.comment: 4,200gns 2yo; has good standard to aim at on debut and is probably best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 13,500gns foal, 85,000gns yearling, 4,200gns 2yo; brother to 7f-9.7f winner Leopold Bloom (including Italy; RPR 75), half-brother to winners Conservationist (1m 2yo; 92) and Custodian (6f 2yo; 81); dam 5f winner (including Listed; 98) from smart family; has good standard to aim at on debut and is probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Lighting Thunder
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid form figures and the class edge from Gosden yard, 21 days since last run ideal

runners_data.name: Romanticizing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs strong pace but showed promise on Kempton debut, 31 days off may need this
runners_data.comment: Has a striking pedigree and was a promising third on Kempton debut last month; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: 180,000gns yearling; closely related to 7f/1m winner Firmament (RPR 115) and half-brother to five winners; 11-1 on Kempton debut (1m, AW) last month but he ran well to finish a clear third behind a favourite who dominated; should benefit from that experience and he's a likely improver on his second start.

runners_data.name: Qarreeb
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who knows the course having finished third here last time, perfectly placed to dominate
runners_data.comment: Improved form when a front-running third here (1m) on his return; respected back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to two useful winners at 1m; made a low-key start at Wolverhampton (8.6f) in November but he returned after a break with a front-running third here (1m2f, good) last month; that was a promising effort and he's respected on this drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Midsummer Storm
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has shown promise but inconsistent, 51 days since last run a concern
runners_data.comment: Well held in two runs at Newcastle this year and he needs plenty of progress
runners_data.spotlight: 550,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; shaped with promise when fourth on Newcastle debut (1m, AW) in February but he failed to build on that when a remote third there (7f) the following month; still early days but he needs plenty of progress on this switch to turf.

races.paceDynamic: Qarreeb will take them along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field, creating a sustainable gallop that won't be pressured early. Lighting Thunder and Midsummer Storm will sit prominent behind the leader, while Romanticizing is the only confirmed hold-up horse who will need to be delivered late. With just one leader and a patient tempo likely, this race shape strongly favours the front-running Qarreeb and prominent racers who can track and strike, rather than horses needing a strong pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Qarreeb gets an uncontested lead and maintains his gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for closers and Qarreeb can dictate terms throughout, with his recent course form giving him a crucial edge. The prominent runners will struggle to reel him in from the steady tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lighting Thunder or Midsummer Storm can time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The class edge of Lighting Thunder or tactical speed of Midsummer Storm allows them to close down Qarreeb in the final furlong. The moderate early pace suits their prominent style perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Flag Of Eva or Forever Endless show significant improvement from their debuts
scenarios.body: The patient pace allows a well-bred newcomer to show their true ability and overcome their inexperience. The small field and steady gallop provides the perfect learning experience.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Romanticizing gets the perfect setup from the back with a strong finishing kick that the others cannot match. The slow tempo transforms into exactly what the hold-up horse needs.

watchPoints.text: Qarreeb could steal this from the front if he gets an uncontested lead in this small field
The two debutants Flag Of Eva and Forever Endless are complete unknowns and could outrun their odds
Lighting Thunder has the class edge but needs to time his challenge perfectly from his prominent position
The pace could collapse with only one front-runner, potentially setting up a sprint finish
Romanticizing may struggle if the pace is too slow as he needs something to aim at from the back

races.name: Bet 10 Get 30 At Betano Handicap

runners_data.name: Valkyrie Storm
runners_data.note: Recent course and distance winner with prominent style perfectly suited to track the likely leader
runners_data.comment: Won on handicap debut over C&D two weeks ago and she's a big player again off 3lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when scoring on handicap debut over C&D (good; 10-1) two weeks ago; a 3lb rise for that comfortable success looks fair and this well-bred filly is open to more progress; key player.

runners_data.name: Lillie Margot
runners_data.note: Unproven maiden facing handicappers, uncertain running style makes her hard to place tactically
runners_data.comment: Unexposed filly but she needs a transformation on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in three novice/maiden events including when 11-4 favourite at Leicester (1m) on her second start; now goes handicapping but she needs a transformation on her second run after a break; first run was on good ground and last two have been on good to soft.

runners_data.name: Inferno
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader in the field, should get uncontested front-running opportunity but stamina remains questionable

runners_data.name: Sailor Batt
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with limited early pace, needs stronger gallop than likely
runners_data.comment: 0-10 but he's been placed in three of his four runs this year; should be in the mix again
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he's been placed in three of his four runs this year including when a 4l third behind two major improvers at Ripon (1m, good to soft) last month; 1lb lower here and he should be in the mix again.

runners_data.name: Bosom Pals
runners_data.note: Long absence of 254 days makes fitness a major concern despite previous course form
runners_data.comment: Won 7f nursery (good to firm) last summer; needs checking in market at new trip on return
runners_data.spotlight: Mixed form in five 2yo runs but she won a 7f nursery at Thirsk (good to firm; 5-2) on her penultimate run last season; only 2lb higher here and needs checking in market at this new trip on her return.

runners_data.name: Gwen's Girl
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can track the pace but recent form suggests she's regressing
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in the last three of her four runs including a 1m handicap last month
runners_data.spotlight: Made a promising start when runner-up at Carlisle (6f, soft) in September but she's struggled in three subsequent runs including on handicap/seasonal debut at Ripon (1m, good to soft) last month; still unexposed but she weakened quickly last time and has plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Empirical
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer making turf debut after winter AW campaign, headgear applied suggests problems
runners_data.comment: Been gelded and he's possible improver with headgear added on handicap debut; watch market
runners_data.spotlight: His best effort from three runs during the winter was an 8l third of 12 at Wolverhampton (8.6f) on his second start; opening mark looks on the high side but he's been gelded and is a possible improver with headgear added on handicap/turf debut; needs watching in market.

runners_data.name: Quick Turn
runners_data.note: Recent AW winner faces 6lb rise and tactical challenge switching from all-weather to turf
runners_data.comment: Made the breakthrough at Wolverhampton (8.6f); up 6lb but he's respected back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the seventh attempt when justifying favouritism in a Wolverhampton handicap (8.6f, AW) in March; up 6lb but that was a clearcut success and he's strongly respected back on turf.

runners_data.name: Glasgow Kiss
runners_data.note: Hold-up style poorly suited to likely steady pace, recent tailed-off run suggests decline
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced filly but she was tailed off on handicap debut at Bath (1m) last month
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some promise in AW novice events this spring but she was tailed off in handicap debut at Bath (1m, good to soft; 10-1) three weeks ago; the slow ground may have been an issue but she was always in rear and has something to prove after that laboured effort.

races.paceDynamic: Inferno looks the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should be allowed to bowl along at a sustainable tempo without serious pressure from the prominent brigade of Valkyrie Storm and Gwen's Girl. The majority of this field prefers to be held up including Sailor Batt, Bosom Pals, Empirical, Quick Turn and Glasgow Kiss, which means the early pace will be modest rather than testing. With such a large hold-up contingent and minimal pace pressure, this race shape strongly favours the early speed - either the leader Inferno if he can sustain his effort, or the prominent runners who can track the steady gallop and have first run on the struggling hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Inferno gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The Edward Bethell runner can dictate terms without pressure and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still struggling to get into the race. His recent third over course and distance suggests he has the stamina to see out this trip when allowed to control the tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Valkyrie Storm or Gwen's Girl can sit close to Inferno and pounce late
scenarios.body: The winner from this scenario can travel easily behind the steady pace before quickening in the final two furlongs when the hold-up horses are still finding their legs. Valkyrie Storm's recent course and distance success gives her a clear edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong or Inferno folds quickly
scenarios.body: Quick Turn or Sailor Batt could benefit from a truly-run race where their finishing kicks can be effective. However, this requires the pace to be much stronger than anticipated given the lack of early speed in this field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Inferno stops quickly and the prominent runners also fail to capitalize
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where any horse with a turn of foot can win from any position. This scenario requires multiple pace failures and creates the most open finish possible.

watchPoints.text: Inferno breaking slowly would create chaos as there's no other natural leader in this field
Valkyrie Storm getting too keen early could compromise her chance to capitalize on the tactical advantage
Quick Turn's ability to transfer AW form to turf will determine if the hold-up brigade has any realistic chance
Bosom Pals showing signs of a long break after 254 days off, fitness will be crucial if she's to feature
The pace in the opening two furlongs - if genuinely strong it transforms the race for the hold-up horses

races.name: Boosted Odds Every Race At Betano Handicap

runners_data.name: Principality
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won off higher rating last July but form has been patchy since, needs this longer trip to show his best
runners_data.comment: Acts on most ground but he's hard to predict and is 1-11 in handicaps; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Acts on good to firm and heavy ground; won off 1lb higher at Goodwood (1m) last July but has mixed record since and was beaten 11l in the Spring Mile on his reappearance in March; this is a big drop back in grade but he's now 1-11 in handicaps and others are more convincing.

runners_data.name: Aspull
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 246-day break but showed solid novice form last season and benefits from gelding operation
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 4yo who won on 2yo debut last season; needs close look on his reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Raced four times in his first season last year, producing a solid novice record (132) on turf prior to a lesser effort in AW handicap; gelded since; remains open to further progress back in this sphere and reappearance may be the time to catch him.

runners_data.name: Helm Rock
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer in good form with recent Kempton win, suits this step up in trip at age eight
runners_data.comment: Ten-time winner who has been in good form on AW this spring; respected back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-time winner split between turf and AW; his last success was at Kempton (1m) last month and he backed that up with a close third under a penalty at Lingfield (Polytrack); did well to hang in there from a wide draw last time and he's respected off same mark back on turf.

runners_data.name: Intrusively
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Group 2 juvenile form but has struggled in recent 1m handicaps on varying ground conditions
runners_data.comment: Sole win was as a 2yo and has struggled in both runs this spring; plenty to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Third in 2yo Group 2 in 2024; ran respectably off a falling mark on a few occasions last season but he's struggled in two 1m handicaps (good to soft/good to firm) this spring; has plenty to prove and overall record is now 1-14.

runners_data.name: Leadenhall
runners_data.note: Strong closer now 4lb lower than summer win, showed promise on recent Pontefract reappearance over this distance
runners_data.comment: On dangerous mark and he wasn't beaten far on reappearance at Pontefract; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Now 4lb lower than for his win at Haydock (1m, good to firm) last summer and he wasn't beaten far on his reappearance at Pontefract (1m, good) ten days ago; should get a decent tow into this race and has claims if he can build on that last run.

runners_data.name: Degale
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with early promise but poor recent form raises questions about current ability
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 5yo but he needs to get back on track on this return to turf
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Ripon novice in final 2yo run and he started last season with a close call in a Haydock handicap (1m, good to firm); looks interesting on that form but he's had only three runs since and has been well held in all of them; still lightly raced but he needs to turn things around back on turf.

runners_data.name: Asteverdi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed promise for new connections on stable debut, benefits from previous course success
runners_data.comment: Good third on stable debut at Musselburgh (1m) and has claims if he can back that up
runners_data.spotlight: Triple winner for Alice Haynes including over C&D; went the wrong way in five runs for Hugo Palmer last season but she reappeared with a creditable third on stable debut at Musseburgh (1m, good) last month; that was off 2lb lower than for her last success and has claims if she can back that up.

runners_data.name: Port Erin
runners_data.note: Front-running type with three wins last season but heavy defeats in final two runs create doubt after six-month break
runners_data.comment: Has bit to prove after six months off and he doesn't have a great record when fresh
runners_data.spotlight: Won three 1m handicaps (AW/good) last season but he ended his 5yo campaign with heavy defeats over C&D and at Chelmsford; has bit to prove after six months off and he doesn't have a great record when fresh.

runners_data.name: Winston's Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good AW form including recent Southwell win, faces significant step up to turf handicap company
runners_data.comment: Has won on AW in two of his last three runs and he's a big player again back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo who has won on AW in two of his last three runs including on Southwell reappearance (7f; first run since gelded) two weeks ago; up another 4lb but this return to 1m is no problem and he's shown clear promise on fast and slow ground on turf; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Orangesandlemons
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course win in October but held in final run last season, fair return suggests readiness
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who reappeared with a fair third at Wolverhampton last month; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Added to her Southwell novice win when landing a C&D handicap (good to soft) in October; well held in final run last season but she reappeared with a fair third at Wolverhampton last month; this is a deeper race but she's not ruled out back at this track.

runners_data.name: Tiger
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse yet to make impact for Ian Williams despite French success, needs to raise game significantly
runners_data.comment: On reduced mark but he needs to raise his game back at this trip after 162 days off
runners_data.spotlight: 1m1f winner in France last March but he's not made an impact in four runs at up to 1m4f for Ian Williams; has dropped down the weights but he needs to raise his back at this trip after 162 days off.

runners_data.name: Youarenotforgiven
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong recent AW hat-trick but faces much tougher test off 9lb higher mark
runners_data.comment: Five-time turf winner who has rattled off a hat-trick on AW this spring; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Resurgent 8yo who has rattled off a hat-trick on AW this spring including a clearcut win at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last month; this is tougher off 9lb higher but he remains feasibly treated on his old form and is a five-time winner on turf; key player.

runners_data.name: Barry's Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent type with proven turf form including Windsor win, narrow Newcastle success shows he handles pressure
runners_data.comment: Won at Newcastle in March and he's only 3lb higher after another break; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Windsor (1m, good) last spring and he doubled his tally when justifying favouritism at Newcastle (1m, AW) in March; that was a narrow success but he's only 3lb higher and is respected after another break.

races.paceDynamic: Degale and Port Erin will contest the early lead, with Degale likely to take them along at a steady gallop given his proven front-running style. The pace should be honest rather than frenetic, as both leaders have shown they can settle into rhythm when unopposed early. Prominent runners like Aspull, Orangesandlemons and Barry's Boy will track the leaders closely, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Principality, Helm Rock, Intrusively and Leadenhall will be looking for a strong finish. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalize on the steady early tempo and unleash their finishing kick in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and the field stays together into the straight
scenarios.body: The large group of closers get their ideal setup with plenty to aim at turning for home. Horses like Principality, Helm Rock and Leadenhall can produce their trademark late runs to sweep past the early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Degale or Port Erin can steal an uncontested lead and kick clear
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run and holds off the late challengers by finding extra when pressured. The honest gallop plays into the hands of a horse that can quicken from the front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final furlong and positions matter most
scenarios.body: Horses positioned just behind the leaders get the perfect trip and can pounce when the pace falters. They avoid the traffic issues that catch the hold-up horses and the stamina test that stops the leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Caught Wide
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is very slow and the field compacts turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get caught in traffic or forced to go wide for their runs. The race becomes a tactical affair where position trumps finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: Degale could set fractions too slow if allowed uncontested early lead, potentially setting up sprint finish that negates stamina advantages
Winston's Warrior stepping up significantly from recent AW success to competitive turf handicap, may find this too sharp a rise
Aspull making first appearance for 246 days despite solid work reports, market support will indicate stable confidence in readiness
Port Erin returning from six-month break following heavy defeats, early position crucial given front-running style
Principality's claimer takes valuable weight allowance but horse needs to recapture form shown 12 months ago

races.name: Spin The Betano Lucky Dip Handicap

runners_data.name: Donald
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who needs to secure early position to avoid traffic problems with four others wanting similar spots
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in all three 2yo runs and he needs a close look on handicap/seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability in all three 2yo runs, including a close second in a three-runner contest at Musselburgh (5f, good to soft) in September; should have more to offer this season and he's an interesting contender off what looks a fair mark on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Papa Don't Preach
runners_data.note: Strong course form runner whose prominent style suits if he can grab second spot behind Westgate Warrior
runners_data.comment: 0-29 on turf but was favourite when a creditable third over C&D last time; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time AW winner who is 0-29 on turf but he ran well to finish third over C&D (good; 100-30 favourite) three weeks ago; rallied well in that race and he should be in the thick of things again off only 1lb higher.

runners_data.name: Albegone
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who relies on pace collapse but faces potential traffic issues with three others employing similar tactics

runners_data.name: Komorkis
runners_data.note: Recent winner returning to turf whose hold-up style needs gaps to appear in final furlong
runners_data.comment: Close fourth over C&D on recent stable debut and she's in the mix with hood added
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 5f novice at Musselburgh (good to soft) for Richard Fahey last autumn; left that yard for 1,400gns but she made an encouraging start for new stable when a close fourth in C&D handicap (good) last month; still has potential after only six starts and she's in the mix with hood added.

runners_data.name: Dc Cogent
runners_data.note: AW specialist making turf return whose patient style requires strong pace up front to be effective
runners_data.comment: Four solid efforts on AW this year and he has possibilities back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta) last spring and he's run four solid races on AW this year; now returns to turf but he's still lightly raced in this sphere and has possibilities off a sliding mark.

runners_data.name: Mrs Trump
runners_data.note: Long absence returns with hold-up style and proven sprint finish but market will indicate fitness levels
runners_data.comment: Her last three wins have been at 6f; one of two for yard and market should guide on return
runners_data.spotlight: Five sprint wins but last three have been over 6f and latest was off 2lb lower last summer; has mixed record when fresh and market should guide back at this trip after 170 days off; stablemate of Herakles.

runners_data.name: Herakles
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good AW form but poor turf record creates doubt about surface switch effectiveness
runners_data.comment: In good form on AW this year and his mark hasn't moved much; respected back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Has reached the frame on AW in his last six starts including when a close second at Newcastle (5f; tongue-tie added) last month; record of 1-21 on turf but conditions should be fine back in this sphere and he had a close call off 1lb higher at Beverley last summer; interesting contender for yard that has won this race in the last two years.

runners_data.name: Marajito
runners_data.note: Long lay-off prominent runner whose fitness after 219 days absence creates major question mark

runners_data.name: Westgate Warrior
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with course win whose uncontested lead gives him significant tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: Sole win was over C&D and it wouldn't be surprise if he made a bold bid back at this track
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win from ten starts but that was a dominant display in a 14-runner handicap over C&D (good) in October; mixed results in three subsequent runs but he went close at Wolverhampton in December and may have needed his reappearance run at Southwell in March; still looks on a workable mark and it wouldn't be a surprise if he made a bold bid back at this track.

races.paceDynamic: Westgate Warrior holds a clear lead monopoly and should dictate terms unopposed early. Papa Don't Preach, Donald, Herakles and Marajito will scrap for prominent positions behind, creating traffic and interference 2-3 furlongs out as they fan wide. The hold-up quartet (Albegone, Komorkis, Dc Cogent, Mrs Trump) face a wall of horses to navigate in the final furlong. This pace setup strongly favours prominent runners who can secure clean racing room and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organised.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Westgate Warrior gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: He controls fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges, while the scrimmaging behind disrupts pursuers' momentum. The lone leader benefits from clear sailing while others compromise each other.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners engage early and create a fast pace behind Westgate Warrior
scenarios.body: The sustained speed sets up perfectly for hold-up runners to sweep past a weakened field in the final furlong. Fresh legs from the back prove decisive as pace horses tie up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners create a wall across the track turning for home
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get severely hampered and can't find racing room, while one prominent runner finds daylight to capitalise. Clean passage becomes more valuable than raw ability in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If Westgate Warrior goes too fast early trying to shake off persistent prominent pressure
scenarios.body: The entire pace collapses and allows the most effective hold-up horse to power through from last to first. Mrs Trump's proven sprint speed from deep becomes the winning weapon.

races.name: £9 Racedays At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Oasis Cover
runners_data.note: Returns from 147-day break but has shown enough ability on artificial surfaces to set a steady pace here
runners_data.comment: Showed some ability on AW late last year and needs watching in market on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some ability in three runs on Tapeta (5f/6f) late last year including a 2l fifth of 13 at Wolverhampton; returns after 147 days off but she needs watching in market on handicap/turf debut.

runners_data.name: Dragon Spin
runners_data.note: Seven-race maiden but consistent handicap form and 1lb drop makes her competitive from prominent position
runners_data.comment: Seven-race maiden but she has form figures of 4223 in handicaps; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden but she has form form figures of 4223 in handicaps and that latest third was on her reappearance at Bath (5f, good) last month; 1lb lower here and she should be in mix again.

runners_data.name: Mademoiselle Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits and showed return to form when second here two weeks ago over 6f
runners_data.comment: Just 1-18 but she went close behind Tickettothestars here two weeks ago; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Record is only 1-18 but she got back near her best when a rallying second behind Tickettothestars here (6f, good) two weeks ago; should be unfazed by this drop back in trip and has claims off only 1lb higher than last time.

runners_data.name: Data Fata Secutus
runners_data.note: Unlucky close second at Musselburgh 10 days ago suggests she's hitting form at right time
runners_data.comment: 0-7 but she didn't get much luck when close second at Musselburgh last time; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 but she ran her best race so far when a close second in a Musselburgh handicap (5f, good) ten days ago; didn't get much luck in that race and she's an interesting contender off only 1lb higher here.

runners_data.name: Go Lockers Go
runners_data.note: Improved since gelding with 2-3 handicap record, though 5lb rise tests his progress
runners_data.comment: Improver who made it 2-3 in handicaps when scoring at Yarmouth; big player again up 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Has improved since being gelded and he made it 2-3 in handicaps when completing a double at Yarmouth (5f, good) 11 days ago; up another 5lb but he beat a clear second with a bit in hand last time and he's open to more progress; big player.

runners_data.name: Tickettothestars
runners_data.note: Broke maiden here two weeks ago beating Mademoiselle Belle, up 4lb but proven at track
runners_data.comment: Off the mark with a brave win over 6f here (good) two weeks ago; respected back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the 12th attempt when beating 14 rivals in a 6f handicap here (good; Mademoiselle Belle second) two weeks ago; up 4lb but that was a brave win under a positive ride and she's respected on this drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Stromness
runners_data.note: All four runs this year on Newcastle AW so turf debut creates uncertainty despite prominent style
runners_data.comment: Unexposed gelding but he needs a transformation on this drop to 5f
runners_data.spotlight: All four runs have been at on AW Newcastle this year; finished down the field in novice/maidens events and same story when 11th of 13 on handicap debut (6f) last month; still early days but he needs a transformation on this drop in trip.

runners_data.name: O Fortuna
runners_data.note: Promising fourth on handicap debut but subsequent poor runs suggest form regression, tongue-tie applied
runners_data.comment: Six-race maiden who has finished out the back in last two handicaps; cheekpieces now tried
runners_data.spotlight: Reappeared with a promising fourth on handicap debut at Catterick (5f, good) last month but he's finished out the back in both subsequent runs; a tongue-tie didn't work last time and he needs major revival with cheekpieces now tried.

runners_data.name: Contorno
runners_data.note: Won twice on Newcastle AW but poor turf record with no finish closer than fifth in six attempts
runners_data.comment: Dual AW winner but he's not finished closer than fifth in six turf runs; down the list
runners_data.spotlight: Won two 5f handicaps at Newcastle (AW) this year but he's not finished closer than fifth in six starts on turf; got badly hampered at Ripon (6f, good) two weeks ago but he was the outsider in that race others are more convincing.

races.paceDynamic: Oasis Cover and Dragon Spin will likely share early pace duties, with Contorno and Stromness sitting handy in the prominent positions. The moderate early gallop should allow the hold-up brigade of Mademoiselle Belle, Data Fata Secutus, Go Lockers Go, Tickettothestars and O Fortuna to stay in touch through the early stages. Over this sharp 5f at Nottingham, the sustainable pace will set up a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs as the closers unleash their kicks. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late speed, as the modest early pace will leave them perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays steady and the closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop allows horses like Go Lockers Go, Data Fata Secutus and Tickettothestars to position perfectly before unleashing decisive late kicks. The front-runners will have no answer to the closing speed of horses who thrive when able to quicken late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Oasis Cover and Dragon Spin go too slowly through the first three furlongs
scenarios.body: The crawling early pace turns this into a sprint finish where any horse can win on the day. Prominent racers like Contorno and even the leaders can find enough to hold off the late charge when the closing sectional isn't fast enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: True Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Oasis Cover for the early lead creating genuine speed
scenarios.body: The strong gallop stretches the field and makes it a test of pure stamina over speed. Go Lockers Go's recent form and proven ability at this trip makes him the standout, while others struggle with the pace demands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field and sprint finish creates interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Running room becomes the decisive factor rather than pure ability, favouring horses with good draws or tactical speed to avoid trouble. Those who race prominently throughout avoid the scrimmaging that traps the hold-up horses.

races.name: Safer Gambling With Betano Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training - Part Of RE Series) (GBBPlus)

runners_data.name: Russian Rumour
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 223 days but won this exact race last year and has proven course form at this distance
runners_data.comment: Won this race in 2024 and she ended last season with a 12l win at Ffos Las; key player
runners_data.spotlight: 9yo who won this race (good) on her reappearance in 2024 and she ended last season with a 12l win at Ffos Las (2m, heavy; made all); 7lb higher on her return but she still looks on a workable mark and won't mind what the weather does; key player for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Gentle Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong form last season, disappointing reappearance can be forgiven, and Burke's 7/51 strike rate provides confidence
runners_data.comment: Two wins at 1m6f last season and has claims if he can bounce back after a blip last month
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off on Musselburgh reappearance (1m6f, soft) last month but that was a rare blip and he's feasibly treated on his best form last season including two wins over this trip (good); dangerous if he can bounce back.

runners_data.name: Dino Bellagio
runners_data.note: Front runner returning after 204 days but McCain trainer has 1/12 recent record, needs to prove stamina at this trip

runners_data.name: Red Derek
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who gets significant weight relief but hasn't won for years and trainer Lisa Williamson has poor 0/5 recent record
runners_data.comment: On dangerous mark but last win was in 2022 and he doesn't have a great record when fresh
runners_data.spotlight: Only 2-54 and a long time has passed since that second success; well handicapped on some form over 1m6f last season but he was up and down last year and he doesn't have a great record when fresh; others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Dino Bellagio and Red Derek will contest the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front runners likely to engage from the start. The honest gallop they create over 1m6f should play into the hands of the two hold-up horses, Russian Rumour and Gentle Warrior, who can track the pace and benefit from the strong early tempo. With only four runners, the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the expected strong early pace set by the two leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Dino Bellagio and Red Derek go hard early and maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for Russian Rumour and Gentle Warrior to close strongly in the final furlong. Both hold-up horses have the class to exploit tired leaders over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders settle into a moderate pace after initial sparring
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with positioning crucial, allowing the classier runners to assert late. Russian Rumour's course win and Gentle Warrior's ability become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bellagio Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Dino Bellagio dominates early and Red Derek fails to engage effectively
scenarios.body: The Donald McCain runner can dictate terms from the front and potentially hold off late challenges. His staying ability and front-running style could prove effective in this small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Red Derek Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Red Derek's light weight and front-running style combine perfectly on return
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old could spring a surprise by making all or most of the running. His proven stamina over 1m6f and significant weight advantage might overcome his lower class.
